records.subject: TEMPO-oxidized carboxylated bacterial cellulose (TOBC)
records.object: TOBC coordination double-network ionic thermoelectric hydrogel
records.quote: This paper reports a 2,2,6,6-tetramethylpiperidine-1-oxyl radical (TEMPO)-oxidized carboxylated bacterial cellulose (TOBC) coordination double-network ionic thermoelectric hydrogel with lithium bis(trifluoromethane) sulfonimide (LiTFSI) as an ion provider for thermodiffusion, as LiTFSI exhibits excellent thermoelectric properties with a maximum power output of up to 538 nW at a temperature difference of 20 K.
records.conditions: Double-network hydrogel.
